recognize_zh: 網狀纖維銀染色下，骨小樑（棕色）之間與周圍布滿密集交織的黑色網狀纖維，並包圍數個淡染、未著色的圓形結晶沉積結節，顯示草酸鈣沉積伴隨明顯骨髓網狀纖維增生。
features: Dense, coarse network of black reticulin fibers throughout the marrow space
Increased fibers along the surfaces of bony trabeculae (peritrabecular) and around nodules
Large pale, unstained rounded areas with faint radiating texture corresponding to crystal deposits
Hematopoietic cells largely absent from the field
describe_en: Reticulin silver stain of the bone marrow trephine shows a markedly increased, dense and intersecting network of reticulin fibers occupying the marrow space, accentuated along trabecular surfaces and around several large pale, unstained nodules with a faint radiating texture that correspond to crystal deposits. The bony trabeculae stain golden brown, and hematopoietic tissue is largely absent. The fibrosis appears marked (approximately MF-2 to MF-3), although collagen deposition requires a trichrome stain to assess. Findings are consistent with secondary marrow fibrosis associated with calcium oxalate deposition (oxalosis).

ddx.vs: PMF shows diffuse reticulin fibrosis with atypical megakaryocytic clusters and no crystal-filled nodules.
Fibrosis surrounds cohesive tumor nests that are cytokeratin positive on immunostaining rather than acellular crystal deposits.
HCL shows diffuse fine reticulin fibrosis around infiltrating CD20/annexin A1/BRAF V600E-positive cells, producing a dry tap.
